text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab and world countries condemn American aggression on Iraq.
- Turkish security zone exposes the region to danger.
- Iraqi troops have fully withdrawn from Kurdish areas to former positions.
- Sudanese parliament denounces U.S. missile strikes against Iraq.
- Non-aligned countries support Iraq against U.S.
- Egypt rejects Turkey's planned cordon in northern Iraq.
- Information minister says steps are underway to implement oil-for-food deal.
- Editorial hits out at U.S. and Britain for anti-Iraq stands.
- Editorial says Iran has no right to interfere in Iraqi affairs.
- Syrian newspapers call for the foiling of Turkey's plans for the creation of a security zone in northern Iraq.
- Editorial lambasts U.S. for its missile attacks on Iraq.
